title: Their best is praised in Will's own words when his voice is on
given: a One thing walk with their best, the walk_voice ring on for the speaker
then: Will's written message stands in for "To our ears, this one sounded really sure." / "To us, this one sounded really sure." and "Why it worked: …"
it says how it sounded to us ("to us" or "to our ears"), never a verdict or a ranking such as "your most confident moment"
it was asked as the walk opened, so it is usually ready when the step lands

title: The signed line whenever Will's words are off, late or refused
given: any step Will may write for (their best, the moment to try, a good Take, after a try)
when: the walk_voice ring is off for the speaker, or his words do not come in time, or the check refuses every draft
then: the walk shows the step's signed line exactly
with the ring off no request is made and nothing waits
the walk never waits longer than four seconds (three after a try's check)

title: Only plain, kind words reach the speaker
when: the server checks it before it is sent
then: no digit
none of: fix, improve, wrong, mistake, weak, error, problem, score, metric, cue, willfidence, perfect, amazing, settle

no measurement name (loudness range, pause ratio, words per minute, pitch) and no coaching idiom (draw us in, make it land, resonate, space to breathe, gives weight, as if you, you should, you need to, great job)
otherwise the draft is refused

title: Short: two sentences, 220 characters, one question
then: at most two sentences, at most 220 characters, at most one question
a full stop inside a quotation of the speaker's words does not count as a sentence end
otherwise the draft is refused

title: A quote is only ever the speaker's own words
given: a message Will wrote that quotes something
then: every quoted phrase is found in the moment's words or the speaker's own turns
a slide name or anything else quoted is refused

title: A refused draft gets another try, then the signed line
then: up to three drafts in all, each told what was refused and why
after the third, or a failed call, the answer is null and the walk says its signed line

title: Will reads the Take's facts in words, never numbers
given: the walk asks Will for a message
when: the server gathers what Will knows
then: the moment's own words; how it sounded against the speaker's own usual on this Take (faster, few pauses, flatter, more fillers), only what stands out
the last Take's fix when it rose, this week's level, the speaker's private note
no number reaches the model's context as a fact to repeat

title: A sound is named only when it was measured
given: a moment with no sound read that stands out
then: Will says why from the words themselves
he names no pace, pause or loudness

title: The moment to try opens with Will's line, told its tool
given: a One thing walk whose fix is a moment (a Clearer version or the AI clip), the ring on
then: Will's line stands in for "And here's one moment to try another way:"
the request names what the moment is walked with: a clearer way to say it, or the AI clip
it is an invitation about the moment, never a correction of the speaker
the Sniper's opener is never replaced

title: After a try, Will says how it went and offers a try only when one is left
given: the speaker has just tried the moment, the ring on
when: the walk's check answers (it landed, one more try, or the last)
then: Will's reply stands in for "Yes. That's it.", "Close. Once more." or "Good try. Take it with you."
landed: what moved, no further try offered, nothing asked
one more: what stayed the same, then the one try left
last: a plain, kind close; a miss is never spun into praise
a try the walk does not name gets no written reply

title: A good Take gets Will's line, and never an invented last time
given: a One thing walk with no fix and no moment below the floor, the ring on
then: Will's line stands in for "The rest of this Take held up just as well." before the helper words
he asks and suggests nothing
he mentions last time only when the context has the last Take

title: Will never delays the walk, and a bubble lands once
when: a step Will writes for is reached
then: the typing dots while his words come, at most four seconds (three after a try's check)
his words or the signed line land once; the bubble is never swapped in place
while the page's ring read is still on its way, the walk waits rather than draw the signed line and swap it

title: The chat says what the walk drew
when: the walk tells the chat what it showed
then: the chat records Will's words when the walk drew them, else the signed line
it waits for his words before telling, so the two never differ

title: Off for everyone until the founder turns it on
then: Will writes only for a speaker the walk_voice ring reaches, on their own Take, at a step the walk has
no row in the panel: off for everyone, the founder included

title: The founder sets the rules; their ratings grade them
given: the founder edits the rules or marks a reply
then: the rules live in one file the founder approves; no line is fixed in advance
a reply the founder turns down becomes a row of the golden set
each row passes when two of up to three runs pass (best of three)

title: Every provider call goes through the processing authorization
then: the GPT-4o call runs inside the Take's protected provider scope when the authorization mode enforces

title: The speaker's private note is never quoted
given: the speaker's private note is in Will's context
then: a quotation of the note is refused (only the speaker's spoken words may be quoted)
a paraphrase of the note is not yet prevented by a check

title: A walk played again shows what Will wrote
given: a walk Will wrote for, played again later
then: the replay should show the words Will wrote; today it draws the signed lines (the written words are kept for the page's life only)

title: Will replies to what the speaker says in the walk
given: the speaker answers Will in the walk ("That wasn't my best part.", "This is pointless, I can't do it.", "What did my coach say?")
then: he does not argue with the speaker's view; he says plainly what he knows and invites at most one try
he never invents the coach's words: when no answer has come, he says so
today the server can write this reply (step "reply", with the conversation), but no walk screen asks for it yet
